applies_why: This judge text issues a result of DEFENDER WINS, so the RESULT rule governs whether that award was permitted.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count — two readings: the standing's stated reason is its cited C3 broken-link collision, so retraction of that BROKEN grade makes the standing not count; or the standing's stated reason is merely the separate non-self-supported conclusion, so retraction of the collision grade does not remove it.
why: Because the D2 vs C3 BROKEN grade is expressly retracted, the CHALLENGE STANDING's stated reason does not count and no surviving collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN, so DEFENDER WINS is not permitted by the rule.
